messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 429 rate detected for customer 'Orchid Health' (vpc-opa-12). 5xxs stable, but 429 spikes over the last 3m. Avg 429 rate: 18%. Pager: erin_oncall

erin_oncall: I'm on it. Paging SRE. Ravi, can you take first look? 

ravi_sre: Oncall here. Pulling logs now. Any recent deploys for vpc-opa-12? 

sam_ops: No deploys in last 30m. Noted a config change to fairshare weights earlier today from account team. 

natalie_se: Joel from acct flagged a sudden traffic surge from Orchid due to a batch job. They claim it's legitimate. Joel, do you have ETA for throttling that job? 

account-rep-joel: Confirmed — Orchid ran a large migration job accidentally hitting endpoints at high QPS. They're starting a stop-and-throttle now, ETA ~5m. Asking for temporary relief while they backoff. 

ravi_sre: Checking routing/isolations. Logs show sustained burst on tenant-key orchid-123 across multiple hosts. KV cache hit % hasn't changed. Suspect fairshare config not isolating correctly. 

lia_devex: Noted they are on Dedicated pool dp-3 with shared tenant configs. We can either: 1) apply temporary quota bump (contract override), 2) isolate tenant to dedicated slot, or 3) fairshare weight change + burst window. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

erin_oncall: Priority: keep customer app readable and avoid noisy tenant impact to others. Start with non-invasive measures: divert Orchid traffic to secondary pool (if available) and enable request-level rate limiting to fail-fast for outliers. If diversion isn't possible, temporary quota bump for 15m while they cancel job. 

ravi_sre: Attempting quick diversion. Running route command: 
```
# check pool capacity
redwoodctl pool describe dp-3 --json | jq '.capacity, .utilization'
# attempt route add
redwoodctl route create --tenant orchid-123 --target pool:dp-burst-1 --duration 900
```

ravi_sre: Route create returned 409 on first try (conflict). Retrying with --force. 

incident-bot: Deployment event: route.create orchid-123 -> dp-burst-1 initiated by ravi_sre at 3301234580. 

ravi_sre: Route in place. Monitoring token latencies and 429s. 

natalie_se: Sending heads-up to Orchid support: "We see elevated 429s; we've routed some traffic to a burst pool and are monitoring. Please throttle your job; we can temporarily increase quota if needed." Joel to confirm wording. 

account-rep-joel: Message sent to customer support channel. Customer says they're pausing job now. 

sam_ops: Observability — 429 rate dropped from 18% to 6% after routing. Latency stable. However fairshare continues to show a few hosts with high token drops. Might be hot-shard in pool. 

ravi_sre: Investigating hot-shard. Running diagnostic: 
```
ssh host-74-2
sudo journalctl -u redwood-inference | tail -n 200
# grep for tenant orchid-123
```

ravi_sre: Found repeated "kv-cache-miss" logs and single-host queue backlog. Restarting inference worker on host-74-2 to clear queue. 

erin_oncall: Go ahead with restart. Confirm rollback plan if customer impact increases. 

ravi_sre: Worker restarted at 3301234725. Post-restart 429s down to 2.1% overall. 

lia_devex: Should we open a bespoke contract override for 15m so Orchid doesn't hit limits while they fix their job? Need approval from product/finance. 

natalie_se: I'll open the quick approval thread. Tagging @product and @finance channels. Draft: "Temporary emergency quota bump +10% for Orchid (tenant orchid-123) for 15 minutes to mitigate burst while they back off; will monitor and revoke earlier if not needed." 

sam_ops: Also recommend we add a short-term limit on requests per token/tenant to prevent repeated retries. Can flip config on dp-3: 
```
redwoodctl config set dp-3 request_rate_limit.tenant.orchid-123 200r/s --duration 900
```

erin_oncall: Do both: quota bump + request_rate_limit. Keep logging and add a follow-up retro. 

incident-bot: Approval needed: product-approvals.auto for emergency quota override 15m. 

product-approvals.auto: Emergency override approved by rota: product_lead (auto-granted) at 3301234801. 

finance-approval-bot: Finance note: pre-approved for customers under enterprise support tier. No manual approval required. 

incident-bot: Action: Applying quota bump +10% for tenant orchid-123 (duration 900s). Change applied by erin_oncall at 3301234810. 

orchid-support-bot: Customer update: "We've paused the migration job. Thank you for the fast help. We'll report once system checks complete." 

sam_ops: After all changes 429 rate stable at 0.7% for 3m, CPU/gpu util within thresholds. Handing off to follow-up owners: Ravi for infra RCA, Lia for devex docs and runbook update, Natalie for customer comms, Joel for contract note. 

erin_oncall: Handoff: I'm clear after 35m. Leaving P0 as resolved to P1 monitoring. If 429s >2% re-paging. Thanks team :thumbsup: 

ravi_sre: Noted. Will collect logs and open postmortem ticket with root cause candidate: fairshare misconfiguration + hot-shard + customer batch job. 

lia_devex: I'll add a short runbook step for 'burst diversion' and sample `redwoodctl` commands. 

natalie_se: Customer-facing summary drafted and sent. Will add postmortem link when available. 

incident-bot: Incident CLOSED for thread 3301234567 by erin_oncall at 3301234867.
